verdict.rationale: Warp directly documents typing natural language (e.g., '#' trigger) to get AI Command Suggestions generated in place in the terminal, with real-time command generation and error explanation via right-click 'Ask Warp AI'. This is corroborated by multiple docs pages (Generate feature) and positive community mentions of 'AI generated commands at your fingertips'. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of accuracy/reliability of generated commands beyond user testimony.
